TestSuite: Chemist/Lab and Symptom Management

TestCase: Edit/Update Chemist/Lab Details
Description: Verify that Chemist/Lab details can be edited and updated.
Preconditions: Chemist/Lab exists in the system.
Inputs: Chemist/Lab Id, Name, Address, Contact Details
Steps:
1. Retrieve Chemist/Lab details using Id.
2. Update Name, Address, Contact Details.
3. Save changes.
Expected: Updated details are saved and displayed.

TestCase: Delete Chemist/Lab Details with Open Prescription Requests
Description: Verify that Chemist/Lab cannot be deleted if there are open prescription requests.
Preconditions: Chemist/Lab exists with open prescription requests.
Inputs: Chemist/Lab Id
Steps:

2. Attempt to delete details.
3. Check for error message.
Expected: Error message displayed.

TestCase: Add Symptom Code

TestCase: Edit/Update Symptom Code

Preconditions: Symptom Code exists in the system.
Inputs: Symptom Code, Symptom Description
Steps:
1. Retrieve Symptom Code using Code.
2. Update Symptom Description.
3. Save changes.
Expected: Updated Symptom Description is saved.
